meta.title: NE Japan forearc, 2016–2017 — machine-learning catalogue with confirmability score
meta.citation: Meng, L., Huang, H., Ma, J.-Z. & Ma, Y. (2026), data and code for the preprint "Can human seismologists verify machine-learning detected earthquakes?" (under review).
meta.notes: Score = released confirmability score, a ranking, not a calibrated probability. Tiers T/M/B = thirds by score within this catalogue, not matched in magnitude or depth. uniform random 25000 of 627435 (numpy default_rng seed 0); tiers/percentiles computed on the full catalogue first
